title_zh: 约定提供两套标志配色草图

scenario.goal_zh: 澄清图案和颜色需求并约定提供可比较的草图

context_zh: 新开维修店的店主埃米尔与设计师塔拉讨论店铺标志。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Emil
sentences.text: The logo is easy to read, but the bright orange makes us look like a sports shop.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: Would you prefer a quieter colour? The blue on your work van could be a starting point.

sentences.speaker: Emil
sentences.text: Yes. Could the sign and the invoices use matching colours?

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: Certainly. Do you want me to modify the tool symbol as well?

sentences.speaker: Emil
sentences.text: Keep the symbol. Please show me one blue version and one dark green version, both on a white background.

sentences.speaker: Tara
sentences.text: I'll prepare those two sketches and include a small invoice example so you can compare them.

sentences.speaker: Emil
sentences.text: That would help. I'll choose after I see them side by side.
